picture-pairs.name: Bifukanyi bia muomumwe
picture-pairs.seoTitle: Manaya a Kufuanyikija Bifukanyi bua Bantu Badi ne Lutatu lua Kupua Muoyo: Bifukanyi bia Muomumwe
picture-pairs.h1: Bifukanyi bia muomumwe: manaya a bupole a kufikisha bifukanyi
picture-pairs.description: Manaya a tshianana a bupole a kufuanangaja bifukanyi bua bantu badi ne lutatu lua kupua muoyo. Bifukanyi binene bishala bimueneka, kakuena diba dia kubadika anyi bipeta, ne udi usungula bifukanyi 4 too ne 12.
picture-pairs.short: Keba bifukanyi bibidi bidi bia muomumwe. Bifukanyi bidi mua kushala bimueneka.
picture-pairs.players: Muntu 1 anyi bantu 2, luseke ku luseke
picture-pairs.intro: Tua munue pa tshifukanyi, pashishe utue pa tshidi tshifuanangane natsho. Bifukanyi bishala bimueneka pa tshibidilu, nunku kakuena bualu bua kulama ku muoyo to. Padi bifukanyi bibidi bipetangana, bidi bipeta mukaba wa ngolo ne kamanyinu ka diteka.
howTo: Sungula bungi bua bifukanyi biudi musue kuenza nabi. Bifukanyi binayi ndutendelu luimpe lua bupole lua kutuadila.
Tua munue pa tshifukanyi tshionso. Tshidi tshipeta mukaba wa ngolo.
Tua munue pa tshifukanyi tshidi tshimueneka bia muomumwe. Bifukanyi bibidi abi bishala pamue ne kamanyinu ka diteka.
Biotshila ne bifukanyi bibidi abi bidi bishilangane, kakuena tshibi tshidi tshienzeka to. Tua kabidi munue dîba dionso diudi mudiakaje.
Teeka "Bifukanyi bisokoka" anu biobi ne nuenu bonso babidi nudi basue mushindu wa kale wa bifukanyi bikudimuna kumpala.
tips: Telayi mêna a bifukanyi pamue ne kuyukila bualu buabi: "Lupanza lua kayi lukunze. Utukuuela mabele mu kayi yebe anyi?"
Lekela muntu uudi utabalela atue munue nkayende, nansha bikalabi biambula tshikondo. Mulee ne munue pamutu pa kumutuila.
Shalayi ne bifukanyi binayi munkatshi mua tshikondo tshionso tshinudi badiumvua bimpe. Kuvudija bifukanyi ndisungula dienu, ki ndupapu lua kufika to.
Jikijayi patshidi manaya masankisha. Manaya amue nkajikijilu kalumbuluke ka mudimu.

faq.q: Kudiku tshibadilu tshia diba anyi bungi bua manaya anyi?
faq.a: To. Kakuena montrɛ, bungi bua manaya, tshibadilu tshia bishima anyi kutshimbibua to. Udi mua kuimana dîba dionso, ne kuimana munkatshi mmushindu muimpe menemene wa kujikija.

faq.q: Bua tshinyi bifukanyi bishala bileja kumpala?
faq.a: Kushiya bifukanyi bimueneka kudi kuvuija manaya mikalo ya kutangila ne kufuanangaja pamutu pa kulama ku meji. Bantu ba bungi badi bamona bualu ebu bu bupole menemene. Udi mua kualukila ku bifukanyi bisokoka ne ditua dimue patupu biawikala musue.

faq.q: Manaya aa nga tshianana anyi, ne bidi bikengela kudifundisha anyi?
faq.a: Eyowa, nga tshianana, ne kakuena konte, didifundisha anyi kutentula bintu to. Adi alua mu programe wa Enternete pa telefone, tabulete anyi ordinatere.

faq.q: Tudi mua kuenza mudimu ne bifoto bietu bia bena mu dîku anyi?
faq.a: Eyowa. Teta Bifoto bia muomumwe, bidi bikuitabila kusungula bifoto bidi mu tshiamu tshiebe. Bifoto bidi bishala mu programe webe wa Enternete ne kabiena bipatuka bua kuya kundi to.

find-the-same.name: Keba tshidi tshia muomumwe
find-the-same.seoTitle: Keba Tshifukanyi Tshia Muomumwe: Manaya Mapepele bua Bantu Badi ne Lutatu lua Kupua Muoyo
find-the-same.description: Tshifukanyi tshimue kulu, bibidi too ne binayi kuinshi. Tua pa tshidi tshia muomumwe. Manaya a tshianana a bupole a bifukanyi bua bantu badi ne lutatu lua kupua muoyo, kakuyi diba dia kubadika.
find-the-same.short: Tangila tshifukanyi tshidi kulu ne tua pa tshidi tshia muomumwe kuinshi.
find-the-same.intro: Tshifukanyi tshimue tshidi kulu kua skrini. Kuinshi kuatsho kudi bifukanyi bibidi, bisatu anyi binayi. Tua pa tshidi tshia muomumwe. Ndisungula dimue dipepele pa musangu umue, ne mushindu muakane wa kuyukila pamue.
howTo: Sungula bifukanyi bibidi, bisatu anyi binayi bua kusungulamu. Bibidi mbimpe bitambe bualu bidi bipepele.
Tangilayi tshifukanyi tshidi kulu pamue.
Tua pa tshifukanyi tshia muomumwe kuinshi. Badi batshiteka kamanyinu ka diteka ne mêyi a bupole a disanka.
Biotshila ne udi mutue pa tshifukanyi tshikuabu, manaya adi patupu atela dîna diatsho ne bindila. Nuangate tshikondo tshienu.
Tua pa "Tshifukanyi tshilondolodi" pawikala mudiakaje bua tshikuabu.
tips: Akulayi bua tshifukanyi tshionso kumpala kua kusungula: biseba bia langi, bule buatsho, ne muaba unudi mua kutshimona.
Masungula abidi ki ndiambila ne bidi "bipepele pitshitshi" to. Tshipatshila nkuikala ne tshikondo tshimpe pamue, ki nkutangila buata to.
Biotshila ne kutua kudi bikole, muntu udi mua kuleja ne munue ne wewe udi mua kumutuila.

faq.q: Kudiku tshibadilu tshia diba anyi bungi bua manaya anyi?
faq.a: To. Kakuena montrɛ, bungi bua manaya, tshibadilu tshia bishima anyi kutshimbibua to. Udi mua kuimana dîba dionso, ne kuimana munkatshi mmushindu muimpe menemene wa kujikija.

faq.q: Ntshinyi tshidi tshienzeka biobi ne udi mutue pa tshifukanyi tshishilangane?
faq.a: Kakuena tshintu tshibi to. Kakuena tshiona, kamanyinu kakunze anyi lukanka to. Manaya adi atela patupu dîna dia tshifukanyi tshiudi mutue ne bindila ditua dikuabu.

faq.q: Manaya aa nga tshianana anyi, ne bidi bikengela kudifundisha anyi?
faq.a: Eyowa, nga tshianana, ne kakuena konte, didifundisha anyi kutentula bintu to. Adi alua mu programe wa Enternete pa telefone, tabulete anyi ordinatere.

shadow-match.name: Kufuanangaja mundidimbi
shadow-match.seoTitle: Manaya a Kufuanangaja Mundidimbi bua Bantu Badi ne Lutatu lua Kupua Muoyo: Tshianana ku Enternete
shadow-match.h1: Kufuanangaja mundidimbi: manaya a bupole a bifukanyi
shadow-match.description: Mundidimbi mufike kulu, bifukanyi bibidi too ne binayi kuinshi. Tua pa tshifukanyi tshidi tshienza mundidimbi au. Manaya a tshianana a bupole a kufuanangaja mundidimbi bua bantu badi ne lutatu lua kupua muoyo, kakuyi diba dia kubadika.
shadow-match.short: Tangila mundidimbi ne tua pa tshifukanyi tshidi tshitutshitu.
shadow-match.intro: Kufuanangaja mundidimbi mmudimu mumanyike bimpe wa mu mikanda mifunda, kadi apa udi ne bifukanyi binene kakuyi tshintu tshia kupatula ku tshiamu to. Mundidimbi wa bupole udi kulu kua skrini ne bifukanyi bibidi, bisatu anyi binayi bidi bindila kuinshi. Tua pa tshidi tshienza mundidimbi au. Bintu bidi ne nseke bu mudi kakinga, mangunza anyi lupanza lua kayi bidi bipepele kabidi bua kuyukila bualu buabi.
howTo: Sungula bifukanyi bibidi, bisatu anyi binayi bua kusungulamu. Bibidi mbimpe bitambe bualu bidi bipepele.
Tangilayi mundidimbi pamue. Mbua mushindu kayi? Mmutshilame anyi mmubulungana?
Tua pa tshifukanyi tshidi tshienza mundidimbi au. Dîna diatsho didi dimueneka kuinshi kua mundidimbi.
Biotshila ne udi mutue pa tshifukanyi tshikuabu, manaya adi patupu atela dîna diatsho ne bindila. Nuangate tshikondo tshienu.
Tua pa "Mundidimbi mulondolodi" pawikala mudiakaje bua mukuabu.
tips: Londa mikalo ya mundidimbi ne munue ne nuakule bua mushindu udiye.
Bikala mundidimbi umueneka mukole lelu, nualukile ku Keba tshidi tshia muomumwe, muaba udi bifukanyi bifuanangane bimpe.
Akulayi bua tshifukanyi panyima pa dimonika diatsho: "Tuvua ne mangunza a nunku kale."

faq.q: Kudiku tshibadilu tshia diba anyi bungi bua manaya anyi?
faq.a: To. Kakuena montrɛ, bungi bua manaya, tshibadilu tshia bishima anyi kutshimbibua to. Udi mua kuimana dîba dionso, ne kuimana munkatshi mmushindu muimpe menemene wa kujikija.

faq.q: Kulingakanya bimvule kudi kwimpe kudi bantu badi ne lutatu lwa kwilwa malu anyi?
faq.a: Bidi bibwanya kwikala mudimu musengelele kabidi mwipele kudi bantu bamo, nangananga mu bitupa bya ku mbangilo. Mbidi ya bintu idi yambula kumanyikwa kupita bishima. Bidi bwa disanka ne kwisambila pamwe, ke bwa kuteta muntu to, kabidi kabidiko byondopa anyi kulesha lubilo lwa disama dya kwilwa malu to. Shi bidi bifikitsa munda, tombelai Keba bya mutyindo umo anyi talai patupu bifwatulo pamwe.

faq.q: Bidi bipita namani shi muntu afinya pa kifwatulo kishi kyashikila?
faq.a: Kakwena kintu kibi kipita to. Kakwena lubila lwa kusaula, musalaba mukunze anyi kwelakana. Mulangwe utela difuku dya kifwatulo kifinye ne kwilaija muntu afinye dikwabo.

faq.q: Bidi bya bitupu anyi, ne bidi bilomba kwikwatyija anyi?
faq.a: Iyo, bidi bya bitupu, ne kakwena kompte, kwikwatyija anyi kutentula kintu to. Bidi byenda mu musoko wa entelenete pa foni, tablo anyi ordinatere.

sort-together.name: Tulanya pamwe
sort-together.seoTitle: Mulangwe wa Kutulanya bwa Bantu badi ne Lutatu lwa Kwilwa Malu: Tulanya Pamwe
sort-together.h1: Tulanya Pamwe: Mudimu wa Kutulanya Bifwatulo
sort-together.description: Finya pa kifwatulo, kashika finya pa kisaka mwafwaninwa kwenda: kizuku anyi budimi, bikeno anyi banyama. Mudimu utukile kabidi wa bitupu wa kutulanya bwa bantu badi ne lutatu lwa kwilwa malu.
sort-together.short: Tula kifwatulo ne kifwatulo mu kisaka kyako: kizuku anyi budimi, ne bikwabo.
sort-together.intro: Kutulanya bintu i mudimu wijiwe kabidi usangaja wa moba onso, pamo bwa kulongolola bintu bya ku ngenda anyi kuluka masose. Finya pa kifwatulo, kashika finya pa kisaka mwafwaninwa kutwela. Kakwena lubilo ne kakwena kilubo to.
howTo: Tonga mutwe wa mwanda: kizuku ne budimi, bikeno ne banyama, anyi ku nshibo ne kwenda mwendo.
Finya pa kifwatulo. Kibwanya mutshila wa oolo.
Finya pa kisaka mwafwaninwa kutwela. Kifwatulo kitwela mu kisaka kyo kine.
Shi kibwanya kutwela mu kisaka kikwabo, mulangwe wisamba bipepele ne kwilaija.
Ponso papwa kutulanywa bifwatulo, talai bidi mu bisaka pamwe.
tips: Mu bwikalo bwa moba onso, kantu kabi kakokeji kwikala ponso to. Shi muntu wanena amba kisuki kya mema kifwaninwe kwikala mu kizuku, mwipangule kine kyawanenena namino. Ubwanya kwivwana mwanda mulenga.
Ingidijai bifwatulo bwa kushilula kwisamba: "I bika byowadimi mu budimi bwobe?"
Kutulanya bintu bya binebine, pamo bwa bitwelo ne masumu anyi buto pa mutyindo wa langi, i kantu kampe kakwabo kashikila kutaluka ku kilonji.

faq.q: Kudi nsaa anyi manota anyi?
faq.a: Mhm. Kakwena nsaa, manota, kubala misusa anyi kukimbwa to. Ubwanya kwimana pa kyaba kyonso, ne kwimana pa bukata i muswelo mwimpe wa kupwija.

faq.q: Mwanda waka kutulanya?
faq.a: Bantu bavule basenswe kutulanya mwanda bimwekanga pamo bwa mudimu wijiwe kabidi wa kamweno. Bidi kabidi byambula kwisamba pa bifwatulo pomukidi mu mudimu.

faq.q: Bidi bya bitupu anyi, ne bidi bilomba kwikwatyija anyi?
faq.a: Iyo, bidi bya bitupu, ne kakwena kompte, kwikwatyija anyi kutentula kintu to. Bidi byenda mu musoko wa entelenete pa foni, tablo anyi ordinatere.

picture-puzzle.name: Puzle wa bifwatulo
picture-puzzle.seoTitle: Puzle Mwipele bwa Bantu badi ne Lutatu lwa Kwilwa Malu: Bitupa 4 anyi 9
picture-puzzle.description: Puzle mwipele wa pa entelenete bwa bantu badi ne lutatu lwa kwilwa malu: bitupa bikatampe 4 anyi 9, kifwatulo kyonso kimwekanga, kabidi ufinya pa bitupa bibidi bwa kwibishinta.
picture-puzzle.short: Finya pa bitupa bibidi bwa kwibishinta kufika ne pabwanya kifwatulo kyonso.
picture-puzzle.intro: Kifwatulo kisangaja kitetwe mu bitupa bikatampe binaneyi anyi kitema ne kubulakanibwa. Kifwatulo kyonso kimwekanga bwa kwimukwasha. Finya pa kitupa kimo, kashika pa kikwabo, bishinta byaba. Kakwena mwanda wa kukoka kitupa to.
howTo: Tonga kifwatulo ne bitupa 4 anyi 9. Bitupa binaneyi i kibangilo kimpe kitukile.
Tala kifwatulo kyonso kimwekanga peulu.
Finya pa kitupa, kashika finya pa kifuko pafwaninwe kwenda. Bitupa bibidi bishinta byaba.
Bitupa bitwelanga pa kifuko kyabyo bipanwanga kano kalambula katyetye.
Pabwanya kifwatulo kyonso, sangalai nako pamwe, kashika tongai kikwabo.
tips: Kufinya pa bitupa bibidi bwa kwibishinta kudi kwipele nakampata kudi bantu bavule kupita kukoka.
Isambai pa kifwatulo ponso pokibungila pamwe: "Talapo musaka mukunze awu."
Puzle wa binebine wa mityi wa bitupa bikatampe 12 kufika ku 24 nandi i mudimu mulenga wa pa meza.

faq.q: Kudi nsaa anyi manota anyi?
faq.a: Mhm. Kakwena nsaa, manota, kubala misusa anyi kukimbwa to. Ubwanya kwimana pa kyaba kyonso, ne kwimana pa bukata i muswelo mwimpe wa kupwija.

faq.q: Bidi bilomba kukoka bitupa anyi?
faq.a: Mhm. Finya pa kitupa kimo, kashika finya pa kikwabo, bishinta byaba. Kino kipepele nakampata shi kuboko kudi kutetema anyi pa kilonji katyetye.

faq.q: Bidi bya bitupu anyi, ne bidi bilomba kwikwatyija anyi?
faq.a: Iyo, bidi bya bitupu, ne kakwena kompte, kwikwatyija anyi kutentula kintu to. Bidi byenda mu musoko wa entelenete pa foni, tablo anyi ordinatere.

finish-the-saying.name: Kumbaja nkindi
finish-the-saying.seoTitle: Kumbaja Nkindi: Mulangwe wa Nkindi bwa Bakulumpe
finish-the-saying.description: Nkindi yijiwe ya bwikalo idi ibudilwe kishima kya mfulo, pamo bwa "Bupeta bwa muntu i bupeta bwa ___". Finya pa bishima byakutonga anyi lomboja mfulo, kashika isambai pa kyo kine.
finish-the-saying.short: Kumbajai nkindi yijiwe pamwe, kashika isambai pa yo mine.
finish-the-saying.intro: Nkindi ya kala ivudile kwijikwa mu bwikalo bonso bwa muntu. Mukanda ne mukanda ulomboja nkindi yijiwe ibudilwe kishima kya mfulo, bishima bisatu byakutonga, ne buto wa "Lomboja mfulo". Papwa kulomboja mfulo, kwiipangula kutukile kutambula mwanda wa kwisamba.
howTo: Tangai nkindi peulu pamwe na diwi.
Finya pa kishima kipwija mwanda, anyi finya pa "Lomboja mfulo".
Tangai nkindi yonso monka ne kwisamba pa yo kwingidija kwiipangula kudinako.
Finya pa "Nkindi ilonda" pomukidi beteakanye.
tips: Tangai kapepele ne kusha kakaba katyetye kumeso kwa kishima kya mfulo. Misusa mivule bantu batelanga kyo kishima kumeso kwa mfulo yobe.
Shi muntu wapa mfulo ingi, sangalai nayo. Myendele ya nkindi imo ishintanga mungya bisaka anyi bifuko.
Mu kibumbo, muntu umo utanganga kashika bonso babungila pa mfulo.

faq.q: Kudi nsaa anyi manota anyi?
faq.a: To. Kakwena dwele dia dîba, bungi bwa manota, mbadilu wa misangu anyi kutshimbibwa to. Nudi mua kwimana pa dîba dionso didi dinusankisha, ne kwimanyina munkatshi kudi bimpe be mudi nkomenu mulenga.

faq.q: Kadi bitwasungula muaku mushilangane nansha?
faq.a: Manaya aa adi aleja nshikidilu udi mumanyike ne kupita ku diyakula. Kakwena bungi bwa manota to, ne diandamuna dishilangane didi bimpe bikole.

faq.q: Mbidia tshianana anyi, ne bidi bikengela kudifundisha anyi?
faq.a: Eyowa, mbidia tshianana, ne kakwena konte, didifundisha anyi kutentula bintu to. Bidi byenda bimpe mu konteinateur wa Enternete pa telefone, tabuleti anyi ku ordinatere.

word-search.name: Kukeba miaku ne maleta manene
word-search.seoTitle: Kukeba miaku ne maleta manene bua bantu bapua bintu muoyo, bidi mua kupulintshibwa
word-search.description: Kukeba miaku dia tshianana ne maleta manene bua bakulumpe ne bantu badi ne lutatu lua kupua bintu muoyo. Miaku yidi mikese, maleta manene, miaku idi ya kulama ku buseke ne kutula panshi patupu. Nayi pa Enternete anyi pulintshi pa kapepela.
word-search.short: Maleta manene, miaku mikese, ku buseke ne kutula panshi patupu. Bidi mua kupulintshibwa kabidi.
word-search.intro: Kakatshila kakese ka maleta manene ne miaku mikese patupu, yonsu idi ibadika ku buseke anyi ku mutu kutula panshi. Finya pa dileta dia kumpala dia muaku, pashishe finya pa dileta diandi dia ndekelu. Nudi basue kapepela anyi? Pulintshayi kakatshila kapia-kapia mu difinya dimwe patupu.
howTo: Sungulayi tshiena-bualu ne bunene bua kakatshila.
Tangilayi mulongo wa miaku. Miaku idi ibadika ku buseke (kumbukila ku dia bakaji mutangile ku dia balume) anyi ku mutu kutula panshi.
Finyayi pa dileta dia kumpala dia muaku, pashishe finyayi pa dileta diandi dia ndekelu.
Muaku unudi bapete udi utemeshibwa langi ne batusa pa mulongo.
Finyayi "Pulintsha dinaya edi" bua kunaya pa kapepela ne kreyon anyi feti.
tips: Lejayi muaku mu mulongo ne kebayi dileta diawu dia kumpala pamwe chete.
Pa kapepela, felete wa kuleja malangi udi mwipepele bua kukwata kupita kreyon.
Yakulayi pa miaku ya tshiena-bualu. Miaku ya bimuma idi nshindamenu mulenga bua kuvuluka dipuola dia bimuma, kulamba anyi bikadilu bia ku tshisalu.

faq.q: Kudiku dwele dia dîba anyi bungi bwa manota anyi?
faq.a: To. Kakwena dwele dia dîba, bungi bwa manota, mbadilu wa misangu anyi kutshimbibwa to. Nudi mua kwimana pa dîba dionso didi dinusankisha, ne kwimanyina munkatshi kudi bimpe be mudi nkomenu mulenga.

faq.q: Ndi mua kupulintsha dinaya dia kukeba miaku edi anyi?
faq.a: Eyowa. Finyayi "Pulintsha dinaya edi" bua kupulintsha kakatshila ka katataka ne maleta manene, kusangisha mulongo wa miaku kuinshi kwaku. Dinaya dipia-dionso didi dishilangane ne dikwabu.

faq.q: Mbidia tshianana anyi, ne bidi bikengela kudifundisha anyi?
faq.a: Eyowa, mbidia tshianana, ne kakwena konte, didifundisha anyi kutentula bintu to. Bidi byenda bimpe mu konteinateur wa Enternete pa telefone, tabuleti anyi ku ordinatere.

coloring.name: Mabeji a kuela malangi
coloring.seoTitle: Mabeji a kuela malangi bua bakulumpe badi bapua bintu muoyo (Tshianana)
coloring.description: Mabeji mapepele a kuela malangi bua bakulumpe ne bitupa binene: finyayi langi, pashishe finyayi pa tshimfuanyi. Kakwena difiika anyi bukoya, kakwena langi mubi to, ne dibeji dionso didi mua kupulintshibwa tshianana.
coloring.short: Finyayi langi, pashishe pa tshitupa tshia tshimfuanyi. Nudi mua kupulintsha mabeji kabidi.
coloring.intro: Mabeji adi ne bimfuanyi binene ne bipepele: bilongo mu kanu, nzubu, lupasa lua tiyi, tshimpumpu ne buatu bua mpepele. Finyayi langi, pashishe finyayi pa tshitupa tshia tshimfuanyi bua kuwuja langi. Kakwena langi mubi to.
howTo: Sungulayi dibeji.
Finyayi langi. Langi yonso udi ne dîna diandi difunda pawu.
Finyayi pa tshitupa tshia tshimfuanyi bua kuujapu langi au.
Nudi mua kushintulula meji pa dîba dionso pa kuelapu kabidi langi mukwabu.
Finyayi "Pulintsha dibeji edi" bua kupeta dibeji ditoke dia kuela malangi ne kreyon anyi feti.
tips: Fidilayi malangi abidi patupu bua kusungula pamutu pa kuafila onso pamwe bitwikala kusungula kudi ne kapepele kakese.
Miti ya langi wa dikalala ne dîba dia langi wa buloba mbidianyakidila. Tshipatshila nkusanka ne malangi, ki ndilondolola bimpe to.
Mabeji mapulintsha adi enda bimpe bikole ne feti minene anyi kreyon idi mipite bunene, bualu idi mipepele bua kukwata.

faq.q: Kudiku dwele dia dîba anyi bungi bwa manota anyi?
faq.a: To. Kakwena dwele dia dîba, bungi bwa manota, mbadilu wa misangu anyi kutshimbibwa to. Nudi mua kwimana pa dîba dionso didi dinusankisha, ne kwimanyina munkatshi kudi bimpe be mudi nkomenu mulenga.

faq.q: Mabeji aa adi mafwanangane ne bintu bia bana batekete anyi?
faq.a: Tuvua bela bintu bipepele ne bia bupole pamutu pa bimfuanyi bia manaya a bana, bua mabeji aa akumbanyine bakulumpe. Bimfuanyi binene bidi bifwila kuela malangi kupepele kakuyi kufwanangana ne bia bana to.

faq.q: Mbidia tshianana anyi, ne bidi bikengela kudifundisha anyi?
faq.a: Eyowa, mbidia tshianana, ne kakwena konte, didifundisha anyi kutentula bintu to. Bidi byenda bimpe mu konteinateur wa Enternete pa telefone, tabuleti anyi ku ordinatere.

conversation-cards.name: Karta ya miyuki
conversation-cards.seoTitle: Kutwadija miyuki bua bantu badi bapua bintu muoyo: Karta ya bimfuanyi
conversation-cards.description: Karta ya bimfuanyi ne ntwadijilu ya bupole bua miyuki bua bantu badi ne lutatu lua kupua bintu muoyo: kakwena makonka a mukolo, kakwena mandamuna a malulame to. Nzulayi pa kilejelu anyi pulintshayi karta yonso mijima.
conversation-cards.short: Karta ya bimfuanyi ne nkonko mikanguke ya bupole. Kakwena makonka a mateta to.
conversation-cards.intro: Karta yonso idi ne tshimfuanyi tshimanyike pamwe ne dibikila dia bupole bua kuyukila, bu mudi "Mpepele kayi idibi inusankisha bikole?" Kakwena mandamuna makane a kulonda to, ne kakwena tshia kuvuluka to. Sungulayi tshiena-bualu anyi sangishayi karta yonso pamwe.
howTo: Sungulayi tshiena-bualu, anyi lekayi "Karta yonso".
Badikayi lukonko ne dîyi dia kuleja patoke ne tangilayi tshimfuanyi pamwe chete.
Telejayi, sambilayi diandamuna dienu nuenu, ne lekayi miyuki yende mudiyi yenda.
Finyayi "Karta udi ulonda" panudi badiakaje, anyi shalayiku ne karta umwe dîba dionso dinudi basue.
Finyayi "Pulintsha karta yonso" bua kukosa kapepela ka karta.
tips: Andamunayi lukonko nuenu bine kabidi. Ebi bidi bivuija muyuki, ki ndilondolola dia nkonko to.
Londayi mufundu anyi luseku, ki mbualu bujima bua malulame to. Bikalabi ne bualu bushilangane, bidiku bimpe patupu.
Bikala karta udi ulenga bualu bwa kanyinganyinga, itabayi kanyinganyinga ako ne pitayi ne bupole buonso ku karta mukwabu.

faq.q: Bua tshinyi kakwena nkonko ya mudi "Nudi bavuluke… ?"
faq.a: Nkonko idi yeta meji a lungenyi idi mua kumvwika bu mateta a ku kalasa ne kupetesha bumvwu. Mabikila makanguke bu mudi "Mbundilayi bualu bwa…" adi apetesha muntu yonso mushindu wa kubwelamu, bionso bidiye mua kuvuluka.

faq.q: Ndi mua kupulintsha karta eyi anyi?
faq.a: Eyowa. "Pulintsha karta yonso" udi upulintsha karta yonso ne maleta manene, karta ya bungi pa dibeji dimwe, idi midiakaje bua kuyikosa.

faq.q: Mbidia tshianana anyi, ne bidi bikengela kudifundisha anyi?
faq.a: Eyowa, ki mbafute kantu to, kabiena bikengela konte, didifundisha peshi ditentula to. Bidi bienzeka bimpe mu mutebuji wa ku enterneete wa ku telefone, katelebite peshi kumpita.

photo-pairs.name: Mabidi a foto
photo-pairs.seoTitle: Kuenza manaya a kufuanyikija ne foto ya mu dîku
photo-pairs.h1: Mabidi a foto: Fuanyikija foto yebe webe
photo-pairs.description: Kudimuna foto ya dîku diebe bua kuikala manaya mapole a kufuanyikija. Sungula foto 2 too ne 6 mu tshiamu tshiebe; idi ishala patupu mu mutebuji webe, kabayi bayituma kaba kakuabu to.
photo-pairs.short: Sungula foto yebe nkayebe ne uyifuanyikije. Kakuena tshintu tshidi tshitumibua to.
photo-pairs.intro: Sungula foto ibidi too ne isambombo mu telefone, katelebite peshi kumpita webe, ne ilua manaya a kufuanyikija ne bindidimbi binene bimueneka bimpe. Foto idi imueneka anu munda mua dibeji edi. Kabayi bayituma, bayilama peshi bayabanya to, ne idi ijmina dîba diudi ujika dibeji.
howTo: Tua pa "Sungula foto" ne sungula foto ibidi too ne isambombo.
Foto yonso idi imueneka misangu ibidi. Tua pa imue, pashishe tua pa mukwabo wayo.
Yukilayi pa foto yonso panudi nuyipeta.
Panudi bajikije, jikai dibeji peshi tua pa "Jima foto". Kakuena tshintu tshidi tshishala to.
tips: Sungula foto mitoke ya bintu bia disanka bidi bimanyike: nyama wa mu nzubu, budimi, muaba unudi banange, dîba dia dibaka.
Bindidimbi bia miaba ne bia bintu bidi mua kuikala bipepele kupita mpala ya bantu, ne bidi bipepesha lutatu lua kuvuluka mêna a bantu.
Lekelayi foto ya bantu bakadi bafue bikala bidi mua kufikisha muntu munda ne kanyinganyinga, anu bienu bamanye ne idi imupetesha ditalala.

faq.q: Badi batuma foto yanyi kaba kakuabu anyi?
faq.a: To. Dibeji didi dibala foto iuudi musungule anu mu mutebuji webe ne diyiyeleja pa tshiadi tshiebe. Kabayi batutumina yo peshi kuyituma kudi muntu mukuabu to, ne idi ijmina paudi ujika peshi ubulula kabidi dibeji.

faq.q: Kudi dîba dia kubala peshi bumanina anyi?
faq.a: To. Kakuena montre, bumanina, dikumbaja bia bienzedi peshi ditshimbibua to. Nudi mua kuimanyika dîba dionso, ne kuimana pa luseke kudi nkayako mushindu muimpe wa kujikija.

faq.q: Ndi mua kulama manaya aa bua musangu walua anyi?
faq.a: Mu mutebuji emu to, bidi bienzeka nunku bua tshintu tshia muntu nkayende katshishadi tshilama to. Porograme ya tshianana ya Golden Moments bua iPhone ne iPad idi mua kulama bikopo bia foto biudi musungule mu tshiamu tshiebe.

picture-bingo.name: Bingo wa bindidimbi
picture-bingo.seoTitle: Bingo wa bindidimbi bua bakulumpe badi ne lutatu lua kupua muoyo: wa kupatula
picture-bingo.description: Bingo wa bindidimbi wa kupatula wa tshianana bua bisumbu bia bakulumpe ne badi batabalela muoyo, ne tshileji tshinene pa tshiadi. Bindidimbi binene bidi ne mêyi, ma kashon 9 peshi 16, kabiena bikengela kubala to.
picture-bingo.short: Bikartone bia bingo wa bindidimbi bia kupatula ne tshileji tshinene pa tshiadi bua bisumbu.
picture-bingo.intro: Bingo wa tshibidilu udi ne bindidimbi pa muaba wa bungi bua nomba, nunku muntu nansha umue kakengela kubala bilembo bikese to. Patula bikartone bishilangane, pashishe tumika ne tshileji tshia pa tshiadi bua kuleja tshididimbi tshionso tshinene ku televizion, kumpita peshi katelebite.
howTo: Sungula ma kashon 9 peshi 16 pa kartone ne bungi bua banayi.
Tua pa "Patula bikartone". Kartone yonso mmushilangane.
Bulula tshileji pa tshiadi tshinene. Tua pa "Tshididimbi tshialua" bua kuleja tshididimbi tshionso ne dîna diatsho.
Banayi badi babuikila tshididimbi tshidi tshikumbana pa kartone wabo ne makuta a mbemba, buto peshi tshimanyinu.
Muntu yonso udi uuja mulongo umue, peshi kartone mujima, badi bamutumbisha. Kakuena utshimbibua mu manaya aa to: tungunukayi ne kunaya too ne pamona muntu yonso mulongo umue.
tips: Tumikayi ne bimanyinu binene bu mudi bibuikilu bia bintu peshi tûpu tua mabote. Mabuto makese adi mua kukolela kuambula.
Tela dîna dia tshididimbi ne amba kantu kampanda padiatsho: "Mazuwa a lupuishi. Nnganyi ukadi mubande mu mazuwa?"
Sombeshayi bantu badi ne lutatu lua kumona pabuipi ne tshiadi, ne sangishayi bambuluishi ne banayi badi bakeba diambuluisha.
Ma kashon tshitema mmakumbane bimpe bua bisumbu bia bungi. Lamayi tshikondo tshia manaya munkatshi mua minite 20 too ne 30.

faq.q: Mmunyi mundi mua kuendesha bingo wa bindidimbi mu nzubu wa ditabalela bakulumpe?
faq.a: Patula kartone umue bua munayi yonso, teka tshileji pa tshiadi tshinene tshiudi natsho, ne tela bindidimbi bimpe bitekete bitekete ne kuleja dina dia tshimue ne tshimue. Nayayi too ne pamona muntu yonso mulongo umue, bua muntu nansha umue kashadi ku luseke to.

faq.q: Kupatula nkuanafu anyi?
faq.a: Eyowa. Patula bikartone bungi buonso buudi nabuo dijinga, misangu yonso iudi musue, bua webe nkayebe peshi bua tshisumbu.

faq.q: Bantu badi mua kunaya kabayi babala anyi?
faq.a: Eyowa. Kashon konso ntshididimbi tshinene, tshidi ne dîna diatsho kuinshi bua badi banange miaku.

calm-breathing.name: Dieyeka ditalala
calm-breathing.seoTitle: Dikuatshisha ditalala dia kuikisha bua bakulumpe ne batabaledi
calm-breathing.description: Ditukija dipepele dia kueyeka ditalala dia kuabanya: tshijingidilu tshipole tshidi tshitanta ne tshikepela bua mupuya misangu isambombo. Wewe udi utshibangisha, ne udi mua kutshimanyika dîba dionso.
calm-breathing.short: Tshijingidilu tshikese tshia kueyeka natsho pamue. Bangisha ne imanyika dîba diudi musue.
calm-breathing.intro: Imue misangu mudimu mutambe buimpe nditukija dia ditalala. Tua pa "Banga", pashishe ela mupuya munda padi tshijingidilu tshitanta ne upatule mupuya padi tshitshikepela. Sungula lubilu ludi lushême peshi ludi lupole. Kabiena bu manga to, kadi ndîba patupu dia ditalala dia kusangila pamue.
howTo: Sombayi bimpe ku luseke lua mukuabu.
Sungula lubilu: lupole peshi lutekete.
Tua pa "Banga". Ela mupuya munda padi tshijingidilu tshitanta, ne patula mupuya padi tshitshikepela.
Tshidi tshimana nkayatsho panyima pa mupuya misangu isambombo, peshi tua pa "Imanyika" dîba dionso diudi musue.
tips: Kuatanganyi bianza peshi teka tshianza pa diboko dia muntu biikala bidi bimumusankisha.
Kuenzeji muntu to. Bikala musue patupu kutangila, bidi bimpe be.
Bikala muntu ne lutatu lua kueyeka, eyekayi bu pa tshibidilu ne tangilayi patupu tshijingidilu. Yukilayi ne munganga bua malu onso a dieyeka.

faq.q: Ebi mbidibidibi bia luondapu bia kueyeka anyi?
faq.a: To. Nditukija patupu dipepele dia kusungula bua kupeta ditalala ne kusangila pamue. Ki mbukole bua kuondapa kanyinganyinga peshi disama nansha dimue to. Yukilayi ne munganga bua bualu buonso bua makanda a mubidi.

faq.q: Tshijingidilu tshidi tshinyunguluka nkayatsho koku nshiyi mutshibangishe anyi?
faq.a: Tò. Kakuena tshintu tshidi tshinyunguka too ne panufina pa Start, ne bidi bimana kunyima kua kuela mupuya misangu 6 anyi panufina pa Stop. Bikala tshiamu tshienu tshilongolola bua kukepesha dinyunguka, miaku idi ishintuluka kadi tshijengu katshiyi tshidiunda.

faq.q: Mbua tshianana anyi, ne bidi bilomba kudifundisha anyi?
faq.a: Eyo, mbua tshianana, ne kakuena konte, kudifundisha anyi kutentula tshintu. Bidi bienza mudimu mu browser wa web pa telefone, tabuleti anyi ordinatere.
